reported.title: Missing failsafe for siren timing
reported.description: If the panic button is pressed and held longer than the pulse duration, the siren will not turn off until the button is released, potentially causing it to stay on indefinitely.

reported.title: Blocking delay in heartbeat
reported.description: The heartbeat printing does not account for the siren timing, which could lead to periods of silence exceeding 700 ms if the siren is active and the button is held.

judge_input.spec:
- Panic button on D4 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); siren on D7.
- A settled press as short as 40 ms starts a 2500 ms HIGH pulse on D7 within 150 ms.
- Presses while the siren is already sounding are ignored (do not restart the pulse).
- Print the exact line `hb` every 400 ms at all times, including during the siren.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
- Idle button reads HIGH.
